notes.title: Update 1.20.1
notes.content:
List of the new features introduced in 1.20.1 patch
[list]
[*] Fixed bug with Room-scale
[*] Readjusted the parameters of enemy in Area 1.
[*] Adjusted the aggression of enemies in Area 2.
[*] Fixed minor bugs with collisions.
[*] Optimized game performance.

[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.10 - Physical interaction
notes.content:
List of the new features introduced in 1.10 patch
[list]
[*] Hands 
[*] Physical interaction with doors and some objects 
[*] Pick up objects and documents with your hands 
[*] New puzzle
[/list]

notes.title: Update detection collision system
notes.content:
We've Introduced a player detection system when he is out of the collision range.

If you continue to experience issues after the update, please contact us at help@blackbite-interactive.com
